response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), s AS (SELECT archstat, tally, CAST(tally AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(tally) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.archstat, s.tally, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_average FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
